newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds buoyed, narrow spreads vs Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds buoyed, narrow spreads vs Bunds.

text.p: Longer Portuguese bonds ended firmer and shorter bonds came under some selling pressure ahead of a Fed decision on key U.S. rates, dealers said.
They said yields on shorter bonds would only fall tomorrow if the Bank of Portugal surprised the market with a rate cut.
"Futures and longer bonds ended higher. This was a reaction to the rise of European bonds," a fixed income analyst said.
A dealer said: "Ten-year bonds came under demand pressure and could rise further if the Fed leaves key rates unchanged."
